about_the_game:
Shit slam2 is a multiplayer chaotic sandbox shooter, where you can hang out with your friends, make funny skits, or have battles with them. There are many VERY ORIGINAL game modes which will twist the game rules. Such as warfare where you can ingage in an on going war or just sit back and watch chaos unfold, with TOTALLY SMART Ai and Ai Air support. 

Some many key features: 

  • variety of different game modes:

    • Sandbox: There are no rules, just what your mind contents

    • Warfare: engage in a epic battle or just lay back and watch chaos unfold

    • Knock: Take a baseball bat and knock your annoying ass friend off an island

  • Physical environment 

  • VERY ORIGINAL WEAPONS 

  • Multiplayer 

  • Customizable Players

  • Fish world - Lead developer: I was into games at a very young age like a . . regular . . . child. and growing up I loved to watch indie devs such as Dani dev, and Fancy dev. so I decided to start getting into it myself, what could go wrong. (thisgame), I've been learning for to years and I'm ready to take on a bigger and better project! We are still learning so, please excuse my lack luster ass features :3

  • Totallyahuman15 - Musican/ Cool guy :3 : his ass is asleep rn 

  • Stayz - Developer & Playtester: I’m Stayz the Owner of StayzGamezStudio. It used to be just me, learning how to code with trial and error in Scratch. After a few years I wanted to try Unity because of Indie Game Devs like Dani and others. I made and released a Game but not on Steam. Not Yet Anyways. I have recently learned Unreal Engine so now I can help my friend Fish World. I am Glad I get to help Code ShitSlam2 and more Games with Fish World Entertainment in the Future. I Hope you enjoy the Games we Make.
